title: Reliability & Failure Isolation
description: Study deadlines and retry amplification, bulkheads and circuit breakers, graceful degradation and abstention, and disaster recovery and restore drills. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Deadlines and retry amplification
lessons.description: Design one coordinated retry policy with a request deadline.
lessons.conceptOverview: Propagate a total deadline and limit retries across layers. Independent retry loops can multiply downstream requests and worsen an outage; reserve retries for recoverable failures.
lessons.whyItMatters: Layered retries can amplify load multiplicatively.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Propagate a total deadline and limit retries across layers. Independent retry loops can multiply downstream requests and worsen an outage; reserve retries for recoverable failures.

sections.title: Concept
sections.content: Propagate a total deadline and limit retries across layers. Independent retry loops can multiply downstream requests and worsen an outage; reserve retries for recoverable failures.

sections.title: Worked example
sections.content: Three layers each attempt a request three times, potentially producing 27 downstream attempts.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Design one coordinated retry policy with a request deadline. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Layered retries can amplify load multiplicatively.
commonMistakes: Retries at every layer always improve availability.

lessons.title: Bulkheads and circuit breakers
lessons.description: Partition capacity and define a breaker recovery probe.
lessons.conceptOverview: Separate resource pools for workloads with different priorities and failure profiles. A circuit breaker limits calls to an unhealthy dependency; a bulkhead prevents one workload from exhausting all capacity.
lessons.whyItMatters: Resource isolation prevents one workload from starving another.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Separate resource pools for workloads with different priorities and failure profiles. A circuit breaker limits calls to an unhealthy dependency; a bulkhead prevents one workload from exhausting all capacity.

lessons.title: Graceful degradation and abstention
lessons.description: Write a degraded response contract and a recovery signal.
lessons.conceptOverview: Define which features may degrade while preserving correctness. If required evidence or authorization is unavailable, a clear incomplete response is better than an unsupported answer.
lessons.whyItMatters: Unavailable required evidence should be surfaced explicitly.

lessons.title: Disaster recovery and restore drills
lessons.description: List the artifacts needed for a complete restore and an acceptance drill.
lessons.conceptOverview: Backups are useful only if restoration is tested. Define recovery point and recovery time objectives, include metadata and permissions, and verify restored data against source versions.
lessons.whyItMatters: Recovery must restore the system's meaning and permissions, not just vectors.
